title: Florida House, District 43
what_it_does: Represents District 43 in the Florida House of Representatives; votes on state laws and the state budget.
decided_note: Open seat: Democratic Rep. Johanna López is running for Orange County Commission and endorsed Orange County Democratic Chair Samuel Vilchez Santiago, her former student, to succeed her. ClickOrlando published a voter guide for a Democratic (not universal) primary on Aug. 18, which implies at least one non-Democratic candidate qualified for Nov. 3. The primary winner and the November field could not be verified.
verified_ballot_note: ClickOrlando 2026 Voter's Guide for the HD 43 Democratic primary (https://www.clickorlando.com/voters-guide/2026/07/31/2026-voters-guide-florida-house-district-43-democratic-primary/); Florida Politics on López's decision and endorsement (https://floridapolitics.com/archives/771819-johanna-lopez-decides-against-re-election-in-tallahassee-filing-for-orange-county-commission/). Candidate names for November not verified, so none are listed. Research limitation: every WebFetch (Ballotpedia, Wikipedia, Division of Elections, county SOEs, news sites) was blocked and the search budget was capped, so this roster comes only from search-result snippets and should be re-verified against the county Supervisor of Elections sample ballot.
